description: Source code for CodecAllocator class managing media codecs, including creation, release, and hung task detection, specific to Android GPU media handling in Chromium project.

classes.name: CodecAllocator
classes.description: Manages creation, release, and monitoring of media codecs, with thread management and hung task detection.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of CodecAllocator, optionally with specified task runner.

methods.name: CreateMediaCodecAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a media codec with given configuration and callback.

methods.name: ReleaseMediaCodec
methods.description: Releases a media codec asynchronously and invokes callback upon completion.

methods.name: OnCodecCreated
methods.description: Callback invoked when codec creation completes, runs the provided callback.

methods.name: OnCodecReleased
methods.description: Callback invoked when codec release completes, runs the provided callback.

methods.name: IsPrimaryTaskRunnerLikelyHung
methods.description: Detects if the primary task runner appears hung based on pending operations duration.

methods.name: SelectCodecTaskRunner
methods.description: Selects the appropriate task runner, switching to secondary if hung.

methods.name: CompletePendingOperation
methods.description: Removes completed operation timestamp from pending list.
